rootCause: manga.chapter.get cacheFirst returned the old manifest after the stored source version changed. cached_resources correctly refused old request bindings, but the result had an empty resources array and never re-extracted corrected chapter requests.

implementation.refreshCondition: policy=cacheFirst, a cached manifest exists, stored source remains enabled manga, and its canonical Source version differs from manifest.sourceRuleVersion
implementation.directoryFence: catalogSourceChanged remains authoritative until the Host refreshes the current source directory
implementation.offlineBoundary: cacheOnly, deleted or disabled sources, and a source converted to another content kind retain the old read-only manifest without network
implementation.progressBoundary: historical manifest and durable progress remain unchanged; sourceOrDecodeChanged returns unresolved mapping instead of inventing equivalence
implementation.failureBoundary: failed HTTP refresh publishes no replacement manifest and preserves prior progress

redRegression.beforeFix: FAILED: stale cached manifest was emitted with cached=true, resources=[] and sameManifest exact progress mapping

localVerification.note: Includes v6-to-v7 correction preserving user explore edits, disabled state, custom rules, user-import ownership and deletion suppression. Explicit entire-corpus check is intentionally ignored by default.

acceptanceBoundary: This record proves production Core restoration and data preservation locally. It does not certify a new HAP, installation, VM pixels, paging, progress restoration, chapter switching or source switching.
